name: com.idmetrics.catfishair.activity.CFACaptureCardNativeActivityX
description: The Instnt Android identity SDK opens this Activity when its document-scanning flow requests a license or passport image. It uses a live camera to capture, crop, and review the selected document side, then returns the image and detected barcode or passport text to the app.
disableEffect: If disabled, identity verification cannot collect or return the requested document image and scan data.
